description: edge-preferred-v2-canary: 拦截未知路径或方法
expression: (http.host eq "preferred-v2-canary.dotdot.ggff.net" and not ((http.request.method eq "GET" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v2/preferred/")) or (http.request.method eq "POST" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v2/admin/"))))

description: edge-delivery-v2-canary: 拦截未知路径或方法
expression: (http.host eq "delivery-v2-canary.dotdot.ggff.net" and not (http.request.method eq "GET" and starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/u/")))
